title: Audit: where iteration 0000 spent quota and time without a result
body:
## Goal
Measure how iteration 0000 and the first Policymaker attempt used the environment, so the Policymaker can tune routing, context and limits from numbers. Iteration 0000 failed `stalled` after 180303 s wall time with 0 tasks; orchestrator session #27 took 169 attempts, 165 turns, 165204 s parked, 2.86M codex/gpt-6-astra input tokens for 9.6k output, and its journal reports 14 runner stops on pending read-only actions. Policymaker session #42 first ran on codex/gpt-6-astra (2.76M input, 21k output, cause providers:unavailable).
## Acceptance
- [ ] `audit/0001.md` and `audit/latest.md` (a copy) exist, numbers first
- [ ] tokens per provider/model and per session for issues 27 and 42, with input/output ratio and cache use
- [ ] where wall time went in iteration 0000: agent, parked, queue/preparation, as far as the exported fields support it
- [ ] the repeated or failed tool calls in session #27 (which actions, how many times, what the runner returned), and whether the history/context size grew per request
- [ ] why the codex fallback consumed millions of input tokens for little output (context resent per request, retries, or something else), with the evidence
- [ ] proposals for the Policymaker (routing order, `context.history_bytes`/`recent_turns`, turn and time limits), each with the number behind it and the expected effect
- [ ] what could not be measured and why
## Verification
Every number in `audit/0001.md` names the exported file it comes from; any script used is in `audit/metrics/` and reruns to the same numbers.
## Context
- `.session/exports/manifest.json`: what was staged and what is unavailable
- `iterations/0000.json`: the record of the failed iteration
- `journal/task-27-orchestrator.md`: the runner stops reported by the orchestrator
- `docs/perpetua/operating-parameters.md`: the quota criterion and interventions
## Budget
- `.session/exports/**`
- `iterations/0000.json`
- `journal/task-27-orchestrator.md`
- `docs/perpetua/operating-parameters.md`
- `docs/perpetua/model-selection.md`
